St. James hospital - Doc Watson

From the album "Doc Watson" released in 1964

Original key: Bm


[Introduction]

[ch]Am[/ch]

[Verse 1]
[tab][ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]G[/ch]                  [ch]E7[/ch]    [ch]Am[/ch]
Early one morning at the St. James Hospital[/tab]
[tab][ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]G[/ch]                   [ch]E7[/ch]
Early one morning morn in the month of May[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]Am[/ch]                 [ch]G[/ch]            [ch]E7[/ch]           [ch]Am[/ch]
When I looked through the window and a'spied a dear cowboy[/tab]
[tab][ch]Am[/ch]     [ch]Dm[/ch]        [ch]E7[/ch]          [ch]Am[/ch]
A dear cowboy as cold as the clay[/tab]

[Verse 2]
[tab][ch]Am[/ch]          [ch]G[/ch]         [ch]E7[/ch]          [ch]Am[/ch]
Set ye down by me and hear my sad story[/tab]
[tab][ch]Am[/ch]          [ch]G[/ch]         [ch]E7[/ch]

[tab]       [ch]Am[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]             [ch]E7[/ch]           [ch]Am[/ch]

[tab][ch]Am[/ch]         [ch]Dm[/ch]          [ch]E7[/ch]             [ch]Am[/ch]

[Verse 3]
[tab][ch]Am[/ch]            [ch]G[/ch]                [ch]E7[/ch]      [ch]Am[/ch]

[tab][ch]Am[/ch]               [ch]G[/ch]                    [ch]E7[/ch]

[tab][ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Dm[/ch]              [ch]E7[/ch]         [ch]Am[/ch]
I'm a poor cowboy and hell is my doom[/tab]

[Verse 4]
[tab][ch]Am[/ch]                 [ch]G[/ch]                   [ch]E7[/ch]       [ch]Am[/ch]
